title: readRectilinearGrid
body:
## readRectilinearGrid

Reads one VTK XML rectilinear grid file (.vtr) into vtkRectilinearGrid: an axis-aligned structured grid whose x, y and z coordinates are given by three independent (possibly non-uniform) coordinate arrays. Use it for tensor-product meshes with graded spacing, e.g. stretched finite-difference grids. For uniform spacing readImageData is the lighter equivalent; for curved structured meshes use readStructuredGrid.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Some image filters require vtkImageData; resample to an image when a downstream operation rejects rectilinear input.

Native constructor: `XMLRectilinearGridReader`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `files` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Each file is expected to be in the VTK XML rectilinear grid data format. The standard extension is .vtr. If more than one file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide one file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1,"maxItems":1}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "readRectilinearGrid",
  "options": {
    "files": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
